grammar.numbers: a white card on the stage above Daniel: CON SỐ label, the number counting up (years and dates as said) with a gold underline, its label, a dot grid lighting up; one said while the stage is taken is a small white chip in the header row
grammar.comparisons: full screen (his card slides away): two white cards side by side, rows rising in, the highlighted card gets a gold ring, a navy VS badge, the question as a navy bar at the bottom
grammar.steps: up to 3 points: numbered rows on a white card above him, the latest with a gold edge; 4 or more: full screen navy terminal panel whose lines type in top-down
grammar.eligibility: classic verdict cue (MotionTrack, mounted only while it is up)
grammar.change: white card above him: TRƯỚC tile (old value, struck in gold at the swap), arrow, navy SAU tile counting to the new value, direction arrow from the data, difference in điểm % when both are rates
grammar.trend: full screen white card: navy line drawn left to right, every value printed, last point gold
grammar.lenders: white card: NGÂN HÀNG ĐANG NHẮC TỚI label, the logo tile on a soft gold pad; a chip when the stage is taken
grammar.captionPosition: small dark box between the stage and his card (bottom y 1000); at SAFE.bottom while his card is away

skinAxes.cover: title on a white info card, logo tile top-right, Daniel's rounded card below (frozen cover frame)
skinAxes.captions: 44 px bold lowercase as spoken, white on a dark translucent rounded box, keywords gold, 2-4 words a page
skinAxes.framing: split: info stage on top, Daniel in a large rounded video card (cut-out on navy, or his room) in the lower part; full-screen moments slide his card away
skinAxes.transitions: cards rise in and lift out; his card slides down and back for big cues; spring punch on cuts; standard chapter transitions
skinAxes.texture: airy cream gradient with a faint dot texture, white cards with thin borders and soft shadows, FinHub navy and gold
skinAxes.sound: voice + a whoosh as his card slides away, a click per point, a soft ding per figure
skinAxes.cta: classic white contact card + compliance card
